name: Alette 0: Red Moon of April
source:
A Sci-Fi visual novel about Kohime, a Japanese girl who, after losing everything, set off on a one-month journey riding her Metal Knight.

[Edited from [url=https://neuromage.itch.io/red-moon-of-april]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部科幻视觉小说，讲述了日本女孩小姫在失去一切后，骑着金属骑士踏上了为期一个月的旅程。

[编辑自[url=https://neuromage.itch.io/red-moon-of-april]itch.io[/url]]
